request: pocket money app for my kids Ali and Sara. each has weekly allowance, they can spend or save, show balance for each, chores that earn extra rupees and a savings goal bar

checklist.item: two kids as selectable or separate entries
can record spending and savings per kid

program:
app "Pocket money" coin mint
setting allowance num = 500 "Weekly allowance"
setting savegoal num = 5000 "Savings goal"
table move kid pick Ali|Sara, kind pick Allowance|Spend|Save, amount money
table chore kid pick Ali|Sara, job text, reward money
goal sum(move.amount where kind = Save), savegoal, "saved together", ""
each options move.kid as k
  stack card gap 1
    k head
    sum(move.amount where kid = k and kind = Allowance) + sum(chore.reward where kid = k) - sum(move.amount where kid = k and kind = Spend) - sum(move.amount where kid = k and kind = Save) big
    "balance" faint
    row gap 1
      button "Weekly allowance" tap add move kid = k, kind = Allowance, amount = allowance
      button "Chore +50" tap add chore kid = k, job = "Chore", reward = 50
"Record spending or saving" head
form move, "Save"
"Chores" head
form chore, "Add chore"
list chore
describe:
Pocket money, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- move: kid: one of Ali, Sara; kind: one of Allowance, Spend, Save; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- chore: kid: one of Ali, Sara; job: text; reward: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Weekly allowance": number, starts at 500; "Savings goal": number, starts at 5000.
Shows:
- the total amount of move where kind is Save out of savegoal with a progress bar, labelled "saved together".
- for each choice of the kid of the move:
  - text: the choice.
  - text: the total amount of move where kid is the choice and kind is Allowance plus the total reward of chore where kid is the choice minus the total amount of move where kid is the choice and kind is Spend minus the total amount of move where kid is the choice and kind is Save.
  - text: "balance".
  - a button "Weekly allowance"; a tap adds a move with kid set to the choice, kind set to Allowance, amount set to allowance.
  - a button "Chore +50"; a tap adds a chore with kid set to the choice, job set to "Chore", reward set to 50.
- text: "Record spending or saving".
- a form to add a move.
- text: "Chores".
- a form to add a chore.
- a list of chore; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

request: Morning routine checklist: wake up, wudu, fajr, quran 10 min, exercise, shower, breakfast. Tick them off, resets every day, shows streak of full days.

checklist.item: shows a streak of completed days

program:
app "Morning routine" sun mint
table stepdone step pick Wake_up|Wudu|Fajr|Quran_10_min|Exercise|Shower|Breakfast
let full(d date) = count(stepdone on d) = 7
let off = if(full(today), 0, 1)
let run(k num) = count(1..k, full(today - it + 1 - off)) = k
let streak_days = count(1..60, run(it))
stat streak_days, "day streak of full mornings"
goal count(stepdone today), 7, "done today"
each options stepdone.step as s
  row card
    s grow
    toggle stepdone where step = s
describe:
Morning routine, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- stepdone: step: one of Wake up, Wudu, Fajr, Quran 10 min, Exercise, Shower, Breakfast. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- off is 0 when the result of how many stepdone entries on today is 7, otherwise 1.
- streak days is how many of the number from 1 to 60 have the result of how many of the number from 1 to the number have the result of how many stepdone entries on the result of today minus the number plus 1 minus off is 7 is the number.
Shows:
- a big number: streak days, labelled "day streak of full mornings".
- how many stepdone entries today out of 7 with a progress bar, labelled "done today".
- for each choice of the step of the stepdone:
  - text: the choice.
  - a tick box for stepdone where step is the choice.

request: how many tiles do I need for a floor. room length and width in feet, tile size in inches, add 10% wastage

program:
app "Tile counter" grid ocean
state len num = 12
state wid num = 10
state tw num = 24
state th num = 24
state per num = 4
setting waste num 0..50 = 10 "Wastage (percent)"
let raw = len * wid * 144 / (tw * th)
let tiles = 0 - floor(0 - raw * (1 + waste / 100))
stack card gap 2
  field len "Room length (ft)"
  field wid "Room width (ft)"
  field tw "Tile width (in)"
  field th "Tile length (in)"
  field per "Tiles per box"
stat tiles, join("tiles to buy, incl. ", waste, "% wastage")
"Boxes:" 0 - floor(0 - tiles / per) bold
"Floor area" len * wid "sq ft" faint
describe:
Tile counter, in the ocean colours.
You can change: "Wastage (percent)": number, 0 to 50, starts at 10.
Works out:
- raw is len times wid times 144 divided by the result of tw times th.
- tiles is 0 minus 0 minus raw times the result of 1 plus waste divided by 100 rounded down.
Remembers while you use it: len, starting at 12; wid, starting at 10; tw, starting at 24; th, starting at 24; per, starting at 4.
Shows:
- a box to fill in len, labelled "Room length (ft)".
- a box to fill in wid, labelled "Room width (ft)".
- a box to fill in tw, labelled "Tile width (in)".
- a box to fill in th, labelled "Tile length (in)".
- a box to fill in per, labelled "Tiles per box".
- a big number: tiles, labelled a value.
- text: "Boxes:", 0 minus 0 minus tiles divided by per rounded down.
- text: "Floor area", len times wid, "sq ft".

request: School van fees tracker for the 14 kids I drive. Each child has monthly fee (some 3000, some 3500), I mark which months are paid. At the end I want to see who hasn't paid this month and the total collected.

checklist.item: can add a child with a monthly fee
can record a payment for a child and month
shows who has not paid this month

program:
app "Van fees" bus mint
table child name text, fee money "Monthly fee"
table paid who ref child, ym num
state m date = today
let k = year(m) * 12 + month(m)
let collected = sum(paid where ym = k, it.who.fee)
monthnav m
row gap 3
  stat collected, "collected"
  stat sum(child.fee) - collected, "still to collect"
form child, "Add child"
each child
  row card
    it.name bold grow
    it.fee faint
    toggle it.paid all where ym = k
"Not paid this month" head
each child empty "Nobody yet"
  if count(it.paid where ym = k) = 0
    row card
      it.name grow
      it.fee bold color bad
describe:
Van fees, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- child: name: text; "Monthly fee": money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- paid: who: a child; ym: number. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- k is the year of m times 12 plus the month of m.
- collected is the sum of its who fee over the paid where ym is k.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- a big number: collected, labelled "collected".
- a big number: the total fee of child minus collected, labelled "still to collect".
- a form to add a child.
- for each child:
  - text: its name.
  - text: its fee.
  - a tick box for its paid where ym is k.
- text: "Not paid this month".
- for each child:
  - if how many its paid entries where ym is k is 0:

program:
app "Qaza namaz" mosque mint
table prayed prayer pick Fajr|Zuhr|Asr|Maghrib|Isha|Witr
setting fajr num 0.. = 1200 "Fajr missed"
setting zuhr num 0.. = 900 "Zuhr missed"

qrow "Zuhr", zuhr - count(prayed where prayer = Zuhr), add prayed prayer = Zuhr
qrow "Asr", asr - count(prayed where prayer = Asr), add prayed prayer = Asr

qrow "Isha", isha - count(prayed where prayer = Isha), add prayed prayer = Isha
qrow "Witr", witr - count(prayed where prayer = Witr), add prayed prayer = Witr

describe:
Qaza namaz, in the mint colours.

- the part qrow defined in this app, given "Zuhr"; zuhr minus how many prayed entries where prayer is Zuhr; adds a prayed with prayer set to Zuhr.

program:

request: chess clock 10 minutes each player

checklist.item: only active player's time runs down

program:
app "Chess clock" board ink
state a dur = 10m
state b dur = 10m
state turn num = 0
every 1s if turn = 1 and a > 0s set a = a - 1s
every 1s if turn = 2 and b > 0s set b = b - 1s
when a <= 0s and turn = 1 set turn = 0
when b <= 0s and turn = 2 set turn = 0
"Tap your side after your move" faint align center
box card fill if(turn = 2, accent, soft) height 160 tap set turn = 1
  text a huge align center
  text if(a <= 0s, "Player 1 lost on time", "Player 1") align center
box card fill if(turn = 1, accent, soft) height 160 tap set turn = 2
  text b huge align center
  text if(b <= 0s, "Player 2 lost on time", "Player 2") align center
button "Reset" tap set a = 10m then set b = 10m then set turn = 0
describe:
Chess clock, in the ink colours.
Remembers while you use it: a, starting at 10 minutes; b, starting at 10 minutes; turn, starting at 0.
Shows:
- every 1 seconds while turn is 1 and a is more than 0 hours, it sets a to a minus 1 seconds.
- every 1 seconds while turn is 2 and b is more than 0 hours, it sets b to b minus 1 seconds.
- when a is at most 0 hours and turn is 1, it sets turn to 0.
- when b is at most 0 hours and turn is 2, it sets turn to 0.
- text: "Tap your side after your move".
- a group; a tap sets turn to 1:
  - text: a.
  - text: "Player 1 lost on time" when a is at most 0 hours, otherwise "Player 1".
- a group; a tap sets turn to 2:
  - text: b.
  - text: "Player 2 lost on time" when b is at most 0 hours, otherwise "Player 2".
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets a to 10 minutes, then sets b to 10 minutes, then sets turn to 0.
